description: Declarative PoE1 Campaign Speedrun Route & Zone Topology Database. Designed for easy editing by AI agents and humans.

steps.summary: Run North-East along the shoreline → Kill Hillock → Enter Lioneye's Watch
steps.layout_tell: Water is always on the South-East edge; Hillock is always at the North-East end of the beach.
steps.next_exit: Kill Hillock → Enter Lioneye's Watch
steps.portal_tip: Do not clear mobs — only kill Hillock at the end

actions.text: Equip starting weapon & skill gem immediately
Hug water shoreline North-East past all zombies
Kill Hillock (pulls sword at 50% HP) → Enter Town

steps.boss_info: Hillock: Pure Physical melee attacks. Pulls sword out at 50% life and heals to ~75%.
steps.gem_reward: Enemy at the Gate (Tarkleigh): Unlocks Lvl 1 main skill gem + Nessa sells Lvl 1 Support Gems.

variants.title: Straight Shoreline
variants.desc: Direct NE beach run; keep water on your bottom-right.

steps.summary: Claim Gem from Tarkleigh → Check 3-Links & MS Boots → Exit to The Coast
steps.layout_tell: Town hub: Tarkleigh (left), Nessa (top-right), Bestel (ship).
steps.next_exit: Exit East Gate → The Coast
steps.portal_tip: Use Ctrl+Click on NPCs to skip dialogue & open vendor window instantly

actions.text: Talk to Tarkleigh for Lvl 1 Skill Gem reward
Check Tarkleigh & Nessa for 3-linked sockets / 10% MS boots
Exit right gate into The Coast

steps.boss_info: Safe Town Zone — no enemies.
steps.gem_reward: Nessa sells Lvl 1 Support Gems (Chance to Poison, Arcane Surge, Ruthless, Pierce, Prismatic Burst).

variants.title: Fixed Town Layout
variants.desc: Waypoint is in the center; exit to The Coast is on the right.

steps.summary: Hug coastline North-East → Tag Waypoint at end → Enter The Tidal Island (or Mud Flats)
steps.layout_tell: Stay near the beach edge; the Waypoint always spawns right in front of the Mud Flats & Tidal Island exits.
steps.next_exit: Tag WP → Enter The Tidal Island (SE) or The Mud Flats (NE)
steps.portal_tip: Tag The Coast Waypoint so you can teleport straight back after Hailrake!

actions.text: Follow coastline NE — only kill dense blue packs
Tag Waypoint at the end of the beach
Enter The Tidal Island (SE across water) for Quicksilver Flask

steps.boss_info: Fire Fury (Unique Cannibal near WP): Casts Firestorm. Safe to ignore and run past.
steps.gem_reward: No gem directly in Coast, but Tidal Island next gives your first Quicksilver Flask!

variants.title: Standard Beach (CoastA)
variants.desc: Continuous shoreline along the bottom-right leading straight to WP.

variants.title: Rocky Detour (CoastB)
variants.desc: Cliff forces you briefly inland NW before curving back E to the beach.

steps.summary: Go Left (Counter-Clockwise) over narrow ridge → Kill Hailrake → Logout to Town
steps.layout_tell: Turn LEFT at entrance to take the short ridge directly to Hailrake at the bottom-right camp.
steps.next_exit: Kill Hailrake → Loot Medicine Chest → Logout → Take WP to Coast → Mud Flats
steps.portal_tip: ⚡ LOGOUT to Character Select right after looting Medicine Chest to save a Portal Scroll!

actions.text: Hug LEFT wall from entrance for shortest path to boss
Kill Hailrake (SE camp) & loot Medicine Chest
Relog to Town → Claim Quicksilver from Nessa → WP to Coast

steps.boss_info: Hailrake: Casts Glacial Cascade & Ice Spear (Cold Damage + Freeze). Keep moving sideways!
steps.gem_reward: Mercy Mission (Nessa): Quicksilver Flask + Lvl 4 Support Gems!

variants.title: Circular Island Loop
variants.desc: Left path is shorter and elevated; Hailrake is always at the SE beach.

steps.summary: Collect 3 Glyphs (follow water streams between nests) → Open Glyph Wall NE
steps.layout_tell: The 3 Rhoa Nests are ALWAYS connected by shallow water streams on the ground!
steps.next_exit: Touch Strange Glyph Wall → Enter The Submerged Passage
steps.portal_tip: Ignore Fetid Pool (optional respec quest) during speed leveling

actions.text: Click 3 Rhoa Nests (follow the connecting water streams)
Head to NE cliff wall & click Strange Glyph Wall
Enter The Submerged Passage

steps.boss_info: Charging Albino/Pack Rhoas: High stun & physical damage if they charge you in a line.
steps.gem_reward: Breaking Some Eggs (Tarkleigh): Unlocks Lvl 4 Active Gems (Frostblink, Flame Wall, Steelskin, Dash).

variants.title: Triangle Streams
variants.desc: Nests form a triangle in the middle; streams connect all 3 to the exit.

variants.title: Vertical Streams
variants.desc: Nests align South-to-North; exit is at top-center or top-right.

steps.summary: Tag Waypoint → Find Long Wooden Bridge → Drop Portal at Bridge → Exit to Ledge
steps.layout_tell: When you reach the long wooden bridge: The Ledge is ACROSS the bridge; Flooded Depths (+1 Skill Point) is BELOW the bridge.
steps.next_exit: Drop Portal at Bridge → Cross Bridge → Enter The Ledge
steps.portal_tip: ⚡ DROP PORTAL right before crossing the wooden bridge (use it from Ledge WP later!)

actions.text: Tag Waypoint right inside the cave entrance
Explore until you see the long wooden bridge → Drop Portal
Cross bridge & climb stairs → Enter The Ledge

steps.boss_info: Brood Princess (Cold/Chaos spiders): Safe to run past toward the wooden bridge.
steps.gem_reward: Dweller of the Deep (via Flooded Depths) awards +1 Passive Skill Point Book.

variants.title: Bridge North-West
variants.desc: Main cavern curves NW to the bridge; Flooded Depths spawns SW.

variants.title: Bridge North-East
variants.desc: Main cavern heads straight NE; Flooded Depths spawns SE.

steps.summary: Check 3 Stones at Waypoint (points to Exit) → Take WP to Town for Portal Trick OR Run to Climb
steps.layout_tell: Look at the 3 tiny stones next to the Waypoint: they ALWAYS point toward The Climb exit!
steps.next_exit: Follow cliff ridge → Enter The Climb (or take WP to Town → Bridge Portal)
steps.portal_tip: From Ledge WP (or Climb WP), teleport to Town and take your Portal back to the Submerged Bridge!

actions.text: Reach Waypoint & check the 3 small stones for exit direction
Kill large skeleton/goatmen magic packs for early XP
Follow cliff past Kuduku totem → Enter The Climb

steps.boss_info: Kuduku, the False God: Casts Spark & Shock Nova (Lightning). Skip unless surrounded by magic packs.
steps.gem_reward: No new gems yet — Level 8 support/aura gems unlock upon entering Lower Prison.

variants.title: 100% Linear Ridge
variants.desc: Single narrow cliff path; 3 stones next to WP point toward The Climb.

steps.summary: Find & Kill The Dweller of the Deep (+1 Skill Point) → Logout to Town
steps.layout_tell: Look for a mossy/gold-lit cavern room; if you hit a dead end, backtrack immediately to the main artery.
steps.next_exit: Kill Dweller of the Deep → Relog to Town → Take WP to Ledge/Climb
steps.portal_tip: ⚡ LOGOUT after killing Dweller of the Deep → Claim +1 Skill Point Book from Tarkleigh!

actions.text: Search side rooms for The Dweller of the Deep & kill it
Logout to Character Select → Enter Lioneye's Watch
Talk to Tarkleigh for +1 Skill Point Book → WP to Ledge/Climb

steps.boss_info: The Dweller of the Deep: Physical slam + transforms after 50% life into faster crab form.
steps.gem_reward: The Dweller of the Deep (Tarkleigh): Book of Skill (+1 Passive Skill Point).

variants.title: Opposite Entrance
variants.desc: Boss arena usually spawns along the wall opposite the entrance stairs.

steps.summary: Follow stone path uphill past Waypoint → Defeat Navali cage guards → Enter Lower Prison
steps.layout_tell: Always walk UPHILL along the stone cobbles; the exit is always at the highest northern cliff.
steps.next_exit: Follow uphill path → Enter The Lower Prison
steps.portal_tip: Tag Waypoint only if you haven't done Flooded Depths yet

actions.text: Follow cobblestone road uphill (North / North-West)
Run past Ironpoint the Forsaken (archer miniboss)
Enter The Lower Prison at the top gate

steps.boss_info: Ironpoint the Forsaken: Fires Rain of Arrows & Split Arrow. Do not stand still in arrow barrages.
steps.gem_reward: Entering Lower Prison next unlocks Level 8 Support Gems & Auras in Town!

variants.title: Linear Uphill Slope
variants.desc: Follow rising elevation; never go downhill after passing the WP.

steps.summary: Tag Waypoint → Complete Lab Trial #1 → Take Stairs to The Upper Prison
steps.layout_tell: From the Waypoint room, Upper Prison stairs and Lab Trial usually spawn in opposite corners of the grid.
steps.next_exit: Complete Trial of Ascendancy → Enter The Upper Prison
steps.portal_tip: Take WP to Town briefly if you need your Lvl 8 Support Gems before Brutus!

actions.text: Tag Waypoint right inside entrance (unlocks Lvl 8 Gems at Nessa)
Find & complete Trial of Ascendancy (spike traps)
Find stairs to The Upper Prison

steps.boss_info: Chatters (Unique Skeleton): Cold melee damage + Hatred aura. Spike traps in Trial deal % Max Life.
steps.gem_reward: Caged Brute Step 1 (Nessa/Tarkleigh): Unlocks Lvl 8 Support Gems (Added Fire/Cold/Lightning, Faster Attacks/Casting, Combustion, Efficacy).

variants.title: Exit NE / Trial NW
variants.desc: Hug outer perimeter walls to quickly reveal both icons on minimap.

variants.title: Exit NW / Trial SE
variants.desc: Clockwise wall-hug from WP hits Trial first, then Upper Prison stairs.

steps.summary: Hug outer walls to find The Warden's Quarters → Follow blood trail → Kill Brutus
steps.layout_tell: Once inside The Warden's Quarters, follow the red blood carpet/smears on the floor straight to Brutus!
steps.next_exit: Kill Brutus → Exit to Prisoner's Gate (or Logout to Town)
steps.portal_tip: After killing Brutus, logging out puts you in Town AND automatically unlocks Prisoner's Gate WP!

actions.text: Search outer edges for stairs to The Warden's Quarters
Follow blood trail on floor through Warden's Quarters
Kill Brutus, Lord Incarcerator → Exit or Relog to Town

steps.boss_info: Brutus, Lord Incarcerator: Heavy Physical Hook + Ground Slam + Spike cages. Dodge hook & stay close to bait melee swings instead of hooks.
steps.gem_reward: The Caged Brute (Tarkleigh): Unlocks Lvl 10 Movement Gems (Leap Slam, Shield Charge, Whirling Blades, Blink Arrow, Flame Dash, Smoke Mine).

variants.title: Perimeter Stairs
variants.desc: Warden's Quarters stairs are always on the outer edge of the prison grid.

steps.summary: Follow road until Piety blocks it → Turn toward the DOWNHILL cliff ledge → Enter Ship Graveyard
steps.layout_tell: From Piety's barricade, look at both sides: one side goes UPHILL (dead end), the other goes DOWNHILL into a valley (always the exit!).
steps.next_exit: Follow valley cliff edge → Enter The Ship Graveyard
steps.portal_tip: No portal needed — Ship Graveyard Waypoint is right near its entrance

actions.text: Follow cobblestone road from Waypoint to Piety's barricade
Take the DOWNHILL side down into the valley (never uphill)
Hug valley wall to The Ship Graveyard exit

steps.boss_info: Burning Menace (Unique Goatman near exit): High Fire Leap Slam. Keep moving past it.
steps.gem_reward: None directly in Prisoner's Gate.

variants.title: Valley Left (SW)
variants.desc: Downhill cliff is on the left of the road; hug SW edge to exit.

variants.title: Valley Right (SE)
variants.desc: Downhill cliff is on the right of the road; hug SE edge to exit.

steps.summary: Tag Waypoint → Drop Portal at Ship Graveyard Cave → Enter Cavern of Wrath first!
steps.layout_tell: Hug the inland mountain wall from the Waypoint to find Cavern of Wrath; the Cave is inside a wrecked ship hull nearby.
steps.next_exit: Drop Portal at Ship Graveyard Cave → Tag Cavern of Wrath WP → Return for Fairgraves (+1 Pt)
steps.portal_tip: ⚡ Drop Portal outside Ship Graveyard Cave (or enter Cave, grab Allflame, and exit to Cavern of Wrath)

actions.text: Tag Waypoint near entrance
Find Ship Graveyard Cave → Loot Allflame at end of Cave
Tag Cavern of Wrath WP → Kill Fairgraves by WP (+1 Skill Pt)

steps.boss_info: Captain Fairgraves: Uses Spectral Throw & summons Ghost Pirates. High Cold/Lightning damage.
steps.gem_reward: The Marooned Mariner (Bestel): Book of Skill (+1 Passive Point). Entering Cavern of Wrath unlocks Lvl 12 Main Skill Gems!

variants.title: Mountain Wall Exit
variants.desc: Cavern of Wrath entrance is always embedded in the top-left/top-right cliff wall.

steps.summary: Run to the far end of the cave → Click Slave Girl for The Allflame → Exit via Portal/Door
steps.layout_tell: The Slave Girl (Allflame) is always on the opposite side of the cave loop from the entrance.
steps.next_exit: Loot The Allflame → Exit to Ship Graveyard / Cavern of Wrath
steps.portal_tip: Once you pick up The Allflame, an exit door opens right behind the Slave Girl!

actions.text: Run straight to the opposite end → Click Slave Girl
Pick up The Allflame quest item
Take the shortcut exit door right next to the Slave Girl

steps.boss_info: Stranded Souls (Flicker Strike ghosts): Can surround you in narrow corridors — use Frostblink/Dash.
steps.gem_reward: Unlocks Fairgraves encounter outside for +1 Passive Skill Point.

variants.title: Linear Oval Cave
variants.desc: Pick left or right wall and follow it to the far end.

steps.summary: Tag Waypoint (unlocks Lvl 12 Gems!) → Follow underground river → Enter Cavern of Anger
steps.layout_tell: Follow the direction of the underground water stream to find the stairs to Cavern of Anger.
steps.next_exit: Enter The Cavern of Anger → Kill Merveil
steps.portal_tip: Craft or equip TWO Sapphire Rings (Iron Ring + Blue Gem vendor recipe) before Merveil!

actions.text: Tag Waypoint immediately (unlocks Lvl 12 Main Skill Gems at Nessa!)
Follow underground stream North/North-East
Enter The Cavern of Anger

steps.boss_info: Cold Spitters & Tentacle Miscreations: Cold & Projectile damage. Equip Sapphire Rings!
steps.gem_reward: The Siren's Cadence Step 1 (Nessa): Unlocks Lvl 12 Main Skill Gems (Sunder, Righteous Fire, Toxic Rain, Arc, Poisonous Concoction,SRS, etc.).

variants.title: Stream-Guided Cavern
variants.desc: Exit is always at the end of the main water channel.

steps.summary: Navigate cavern to Merveil's Lair → Kill Merveil (2 Phases) → Enter Act 2 (Southern Forest)
steps.layout_tell: Move generally away from the entrance wall (usually North-East) to reach Merveil's Lair door.
steps.next_exit: Kill Merveil → Enter The Southern Forest (Act 2)
steps.portal_tip: Do NOT logout after Merveil — walk out the back door into The Southern Forest!

actions.text: Run through cavern to Merveil's Lair entrance
Kill Merveil (Phase 1: Ice Spear/Barrage, Phase 2: Geysers & Adds)
Exit North into The Southern Forest (Act 2)

steps.boss_info: Merveil, the Siren: 90% Cold Damage + Chilling/Freezing Geysers. Two Sapphire Rings (Iron Ring + Blue Gem at vendor) trivialize this fight!
steps.gem_reward: Completes Act 1 and opens Act 2 Forest Encampment.

variants.title: Two-Bridge Cavern
variants.desc: Cross wooden bridges heading NE/NW toward Merveil's Lair.

steps.summary: Hug cliff/river edge North-East straight to The Forest Encampment
steps.layout_tell: Linear forest corridor: keep heading North-East along the main gap in the trees.
steps.next_exit: Enter The Forest Encampment (Act 2 Town)
steps.portal_tip: No quests here — run straight into Act 2 Town

actions.text: Run NE through the trees — ignore monkeys
Tag WP at end & enter The Forest Encampment

steps.boss_info: No boss in Southern Forest.
steps.gem_reward: Unlocks Act 2 Town vendors (Yeena & Greust).

variants.title: Linear Corridor
variants.desc: Always starts SW and exits NE into Forest Encampment.

steps.summary: Follow the cobblestone road NE → Optional: Drop Portal at The Den → Enter The Crossroads
steps.layout_tell: The cobblestone road ALWAYS leads directly from Forest Encampment to The Crossroads exit!
steps.next_exit: Follow road → Enter The Crossroads
steps.portal_tip: Skip The Den unless you want a 2nd Quicksilver Flask

actions.text: Stay on the cobblestone road heading North-East
(Optional) Drop portal at The Den entrance if you want 2nd Quicksilver
Follow road into The Crossroads

steps.boss_info: The Great White Beast (inside The Den): Optional quest for 2nd Quicksilver Flask.
steps.gem_reward: The Great White Beast (Yeena): Quicksilver Flask or Silver Flask.

variants.title: Road-Guided Field
variants.desc: Never leave the stone road unless looking for The Den.

steps.summary: Follow road to Waypoint at center fork → Go North-West to Chamber of Sins Level 1
steps.layout_tell: At the central Waypoint fork: NW = Chamber of Sins, NE = Broken Bridge (Kraityn), SE = Fellshrine Ruins (Lab Trial).
steps.next_exit: Tag WP → Take NW Fork → Chamber of Sins Level 1
steps.portal_tip: Tag The Crossroads Waypoint — you will use it 3 times in Act 2!

actions.text: Follow road to the central Waypoint & tag it!
Take the North-West fork (uphill dirt path)
Enter The Chamber of Sins Level 1

steps.boss_info: Calaf, Headstaver (near gate): Easy to run past.
steps.gem_reward: Hub zone connecting Chamber of Sins (Lvl 16 Herald/Blood Rage gems), Kraityn, and Crypt Trial.

variants.title: 3-Fork Hub
variants.desc: WP sits at the intersection: NW = Sins, NE = Bridge, SE = Fellshrine.

steps.summary: Reach center Map Device room → Exit is ALWAYS in the direction the Map Device points!
steps.layout_tell: ⚡ BEST TELL IN POE: In the center Waypoint room, look at which hallway has the broken carpet / Map Device facing it — Level 2 is 100% down that hallway!
steps.next_exit: Follow Map Device direction → Enter Chamber of Sins Level 2
steps.portal_tip: Tag Waypoint in center room just in case

actions.text: Run to the central circular room with the Waypoint & Map Device
Take the hallway matching the Map Device's orientation
Descend stairs into The Chamber of Sins Level 2

steps.boss_info: Black Death (Unique Necromancer): Summons skeletons; ignore and take stairs.
steps.gem_reward: Completing Level 2 next unlocks Level 16 Herald & Aura Gems!

variants.title: Diamond Cross Layout
variants.desc: 4 hallways radiating from center WP; Map Device points to the exit hallway.

steps.summary: Complete Lab Trial #2 → Follow long narrow corridor → Kill Fidelitas & take Baleful Gem
steps.layout_tell: Fidelitas is always at the end of a long narrow diagonal hallway in the North-West or North-East.
steps.next_exit: Kill Fidelitas → Loot Baleful Gem → Relog to Town (Helena)
steps.portal_tip: ⚡ LOGOUT after grabbing the Baleful Gem & talking to Helena!

actions.text: Complete Trial of Ascendancy (Spinning Sawblades)
Find narrow corridor → Kill Fidelitas & click Strange Device
Pick up Baleful Gem → Logout to Town → Talk to Greust & Helena

steps.boss_info: Fidelitas, the Mourning: Pure Lightning melee & Lightning Strike projectiles. Topaz Ring helps!
steps.gem_reward: Intruders in Black (Greust/Yeena): Unlocks Lvl 16 Herald Gems (Herald of Ash, Ice, Thunder, Purity, Agony, Blood Rage, Desecrate, Wave of Conviction).

variants.title: NW Boss / NE Trial
variants.desc: Look for the long thin bridge corridor leading to Fidelitas's arena.

steps.summary: Exit Town West → Follow cobblestone road to Waypoint → Continue SW along road to Western Forest
steps.layout_tell: Look for two broken stone pillars along the road just past the Waypoint: they lead north to Wetlands (Oak), while the main road continues to Western Forest.
steps.next_exit: Tag WP → Follow road into The Western Forest
steps.portal_tip: Tag The Riverways Waypoint so you can come back for Oak in The Wetlands!

actions.text: Follow main cobblestone road to the Waypoint & tag it
Stay on the cobblestone road past the broken bridge (use movement skill)
Enter The Western Forest at the end of the road

steps.boss_info: No required boss in The Riverways.
steps.gem_reward: Leads to Western Forest (3 quests in 1 zone!).

variants.title: Road Spine
variants.desc: Main road cuts straight across; Wetlands entrance is North of the WP.

steps.summary: Follow Road to WP → Follow Torch on Road to Alira → Kill Arteri at South End (+1 Pt) → Open Thaumetic Seal
steps.layout_tell: ⚡ TORCH TELL: On the main road near the WP, look for a Torch and broken cobbles leading off the road — that path ALWAYS leads to Alira's camp! Spider Chambers (Weaver) is on the OPPOSITE side of the road from Alira.
steps.next_exit: Do Weaver's Chambers + Alira + Captain Arteri (+1 Skill Pt!)
steps.portal_tip: After Captain Arteri & Thaumetic Seal, talk to Bestel in Act 1 Town for +1 Passive Skill Point!

actions.text: Follow road to Waypoint & spot the Torch side-path (Alira's side)
Opposite side of road from Alira → Enter Weaver's Chambers & kill Weaver
Follow road to far SW end → Kill Captain Arteri & click Thaumetic Seal (+1 Pt)

steps.boss_info: Alira: Casts Detonate Dead on corpses (do not stand on corpses!). Captain Arteri: Heavy Physical + Bleed.
steps.gem_reward: Sharp and Cruel (Silk): Lvl 18 Support Gems! The Way Forward (Bestel in Act 1): Book of Skill (+1 Passive Point)!

variants.title: Alira West / Weaver East
variants.desc: Torch is on the left of the road; Weaver's web trees are on the right.

variants.title: Alira East / Weaver West
variants.desc: Torch is on the right of the road; Weaver's web trees are on the left.
